spell.name: Fake Bolt
entries: You hurl a crackling mote of imaginary energy at a creature you can see. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the target takes {@dice 1d8} pretend damage.

spell.name: Fake Shimmer
entries: Your outline glitters with harmless sparks until the start of your next turn.

spell.name: Greater Fake Bolt
entries: As Fake Bolt, but considerably more so. The target takes {@dice 4d8} pretend damage.

spell.name: Fake Blast
entries: A shower of dazzling but entirely fictional sparks erupts at a point you choose. Each creature in a 20-foot radius must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 6d6} pretend damage on a failure.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the pretend damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Fake Whisper
entries: You murmur a suggestion so unconvincing that the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or spend its turn politely pretending to consider it.

spell.name: Fake Ward

time.condition: which you take when an imaginary threat menaces you

entries: A translucent barrier of pure make-believe springs up around you, granting +2 AC against attacks that were never real.

spell.name: Fake Cataclysm

components.m: a snow globe depicting a city

entries: You conjure the vivid illusion of an apocalypse. Nothing is harmed, but everyone within a mile is deeply impressed.
